posts.title: Spider-Sense Activated — Spider-Man Reel Demo
posts.topic: A fast fan-made superhero Reel showing Spider-Man swinging through a comic-style city.
posts.goal: Demonstrate an engaging vertical Reel concept and encourage followers.

instagram.caption:
From rooftop swings to split-second saves—this friendly neighbourhood hero never misses the call. Watch the city come alive in six seconds of comic-book energy.

Fan-made demo content. Not affiliated with Marvel or Sony.
instagram.cta: Follow for more fan-made superhero Reel concepts.
instagram.creative_idea: A vertical red-and-blue comic animation with moving web lines, a swinging masked hero silhouette and four fast text beats.
instagram.image_prompt: Create a vertical family-friendly comic Reel cover with a masked red-and-blue spider-themed hero swinging above a city at sunset. No logo, no watermark and no actor likeness.
